personal-dashboard-back-to-dashboard: Accessible label for the link in a focused module page's header that returns to the main dashboard (Special:PersonalDashboard).
personal-dashboard-beta-info-chip-text: Text within an info chip that indicates that this extension is in its Beta version
personal-dashboard-link-title: Title for the Special:PersonalDashboard link in the user menu.
personal-dashboard-module-no-js-fallback: Warning message shown when JavaScript is disabled. Some cards on the dashboard are rendered on the server and display without JavaScript; others only fill in after JavaScript loads, and this message explains why those appear empty.
personal-dashboard-open-module: Accessible label for the link in a module card's header that opens that module's own full-page view. Only used when the module has no header text, so the link shows nothing but a forward arrow.
personal-dashboard-survey-text: Text with link to the Personal Dashboard feedback survey.
tooltip-pt-personaldashboard:
Tooltip shown when hovering the mouse over the link to your own PersonalDashboard in the upper-side personal toolbox.
